historyPolicy: Preserve all completed and in-progress sessions exactly as stored, including old straight-set sessions. Never attach new block assignments to old actuals.
deploymentOrder: Back up the DB and capture active catalog pointers and affected current preferences
Compare live definitions with both supplied reference packs and reconcile real version conflicts
Deploy readers/importers for pack and session formats 1, 2 and 3
Activate the immutable pack and perform only the applicable obsolete-program preference remap
Verify block navigation, per-round actuals, side counts, historical resume and catalog stability
rollbackPolicy: Restore captured active catalog pointers and affected preferences without deleting new sessions. Keep schema-3 readers deployed once schema-3 sessions exist. Never restore an old dump over newly logged workouts.
